name: Osa
title: Hostler of the Caravanserai
examine: Sixty-some years, most of them opinions. Mules trust her on sight.
lines: Beasts watered, wheels mended, advice free.
I kept an inn at the ford for thirty years. My daughter keeps it now, Dunna, at the Wanderer's Rest. Her stew wants thyme.
Walked the High Road at sixty, alone. Everyone said it would kill me. It didn't.
